_purpose: For each architectural alternative that achieves the same technical effect, generate ≥5 design-around variants that avoid at least one limitation. Each variant has a limitation-avoidance matrix and a 102/103 motivation analysis.

methodology.approach: Per-limitation avoidance: each design-around must NOT read on at least one limitation of L1..Ln, AND must still achieve the technical effect.
methodology.obviousness_double_back_check: Each alternative must be 102-clean and 103-clean against known prior art.
methodology.engineering_feasibility: Each alternative must be technically implementable within the buyer's existing device form factor.

alternatives.name: <short descriptive name>

103_check.motivation: <if true, the documented motivation; if false, why motivation is missing>

alternatives.potential_claim_set: <how the buyer could file this as a blocking claim>

recommended_companion_claims_to_file: <list of DA IDs that should be filed as blocking claims>

_rules: Minimum 5 alternatives required. Fewer than 5 → CI failure.
Each alternative must avoid at least one limitation (limitations_avoided must be non-empty).
Each alternative must have 102_check and 103_check (model-derived acceptable if PatSnap frozen, but must be labeled).
Strongest design-around for blocking must be identified and rationale provided.
Recommended companion claims must be listed for patent fence construction.
